title: Module global sections after algebraically closed scalar extension
statement: Let k be algebraically closed, K/k any field extension, X any k-scheme, n any natural number, and G an etale sheaf of ULift(Z/n)-modules on X. The canonical restriction of module global sections along X_K -> X is an isomorphism. No torsion-invertibility or qcqs condition is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 59.39.5, with the concrete coefficient inverse-image comparison

proof.text: Forget module coefficients to sets and apply invariance of sections over a separably closed field. The source k is separably closed; K need not be closed.

The forgetful functor preserves limits and filtered colimits, hence commutes with etale inverse image (filtered neighborhood Kan extension followed by sheafification). Its comparison respects the unit. Evaluate at the terminal etale object, identify global sections with terminal sections, and reflect the resulting bijective module map as an isomorphism. The cases n=0, n=1 and X empty are included.
